- scvi_n200 >> PCA >> scgpt for RNA encoding (when combined with good image encoder)
- ViT-L > ResNet50 for image encoding
- Weighted fusion > concat fusion
- Transformer aggregation > avgpool (but this was tested with scvi_n200 + ViT-L)
